{'text': '喜劇演員Shane Gillis喺周六播出的《Saturday Night Live》其中一個短劇中，不小心講咗一個不雅嘅字眼。', 'paragraph_context': 'Comedian Shane Gillis let slip a NSFW word during a sketch on Saturday’s episode of “Saturday Night Live.”'}

{'text': '喺一個「Green Eggs And Ham」嘅短劇入面，Gillis飾演Mikey Day所飾演角色嘅兒子，當Andrew Dismukes飾演嘅Sam-I-Am不停逼Day嘅角色去食綠蛋同火腿嗰陣，Gillis幫佢爸爸解圍。', 'paragraph_context': 'During a “Green Eggs And Ham” sketch, Gillis, who played the son to Mikey Day’s character, was defending his dad from Andrew Dismukes’ Sam-I-Am, who was pressuring Day’s character to eat his green eggs and ham.'}

{'text': '「兄弟，根本冇得傾，」Gillis話。「佢同我講，佢話佢唔撚——哎呀，即係鍾意佢哋。」', 'paragraph_context': '“Bro, it’s a non-starter,” Gillis said. “He told me, he said he doesn’t fucking — geez, like them.”'}

{'text': 'Gillis睇落明顯好緊張。當台下觀眾笑埋一齊拍掌嗰陣，佢舉起手向觀眾致意。', 'paragraph_context': 'Gillis looked visibly shaken up. When the crowd laughed and applauded, he put his hand up to acknowledge the audience.'}

{'text': '「你係個廢柴，而且你講咗粗口！」Day嘅角色喺短劇將近完結時對Gillis話。', 'paragraph_context': '“You’re a loser, and you said a bad word!” Day’s character told Gillis toward the end of the sketch.'}

{'text': '「頭先真係唔好意思，」Gillis話。', 'paragraph_context': '“Sorry about earlier,” Gillis said.'}

{'text': '監控人員冇抓到呢個甩漏，但喺網上發布嘅影片入面，該字眼已經被消音。', 'paragraph_context': 'Censors didn’t catch the slip-up, but in videos posted online, the word is muted.'}

{'text': '成晚完結嘅時候，當Gillis喺主舞台上同大家道謝兼多謝全體演員時，佢再次道歉。', 'paragraph_context': 'At the end of the night, as Gillis was saying goodbye from the main stage and thanking the cast, he again apologized.'}

{'text': '2009年，喜劇演員Jenny Slate喺佢首季《Saturday Night Live》完結時被炒，係因為佢喺直播入面講咗「fucking」。不過喺2019年，Slate接受InStyle訪問時話，呢個唔係佢被解僱嘅原因。', 'paragraph_context': 'In 2009, comedian Jenny Slate was fired at the end of her debut season of “Saturday Night Live” after she said “fucking” live on air. However, in 2019, Slate told InStyle that wasn’t the reason she got fired.'}

{'text': '「對了，大家一直以為我係因為講咗fuck先被炒，」佢話。「其實唔係，唔係因為咁。我只係唔適合嗰度。」', 'paragraph_context': '“By the way, everyone always thinks I got fired for saying fuck,” she said. “I didn’t. That’s not why I got fired. I just didn’t belong there.”'}

{'text': 'Gillis係第三次回歸主持《Saturday Night Live》。佢喺2019年被宣佈加入劇組後，短時間內就被解僱，因為一啲佢過往嘅種族歧視言論被翻出嚟。', 'paragraph_context': 'Gillis returned to “Saturday Night Live” for his third time hosting. In 2019, he was fired from the show shortly after he was announced as a cast member for some past racist remarks he made that resurfaced.'}

{'text': '更正：本文章早前版本錯誤標示咗「SNL」短劇中Mikey Day所飾演嘅角色名稱。', 'paragraph_context': 'CORRECTION: A previous version of this article misnamed Mikey Day’s character in the “SNL” sketch.'}
